finalText:
**Redis died, and the app never came back.**

```
02:14:07  redis refused connection at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:07  cache off, every read went to the store
02:14:10  store timeouts begin, queue starts filling
02:29:12  queue passes its 500 cap
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory
02:31:52  api killed, service down
```

Everything was healthy until 02:14. Cache hit rate sat near 0.95.
Redis was retried 13 times. Every attempt was refused.
Those hundreds of warnings are all downstream noise.

One thing. This log is dated July 4.
